properties.name: ManagerMemberVote
properties.label: Select the Voting Interest when all Members serve as Managers.
properties.helpText: This is a "Manager Managed" Operating Agreement, but electing for all Members to serve as Managers is equivalent to a "Member Managed" entity, in which Managers can either vote "by head" or pro rata in accordance with their ownership interest. If the entity becomes fragmented based on family descent, electing "pro rata" will ensure the Manager Vote is essentially by root.

properties.helpText: If selected, Class A (Voting) and Class B (Non-voting) interest will be created. Creating separate classes may be useful to transfer value without transferring control.

properties.label: Select the appropriate NAICS Code for this entity.
properties.helpText:
A NAICS (pronounced NAKES) code is a six-digit number used by federal statistical agencies in the United States, Canada, and Mexico to classify businesses according to their primary economic activity.

The primary purpose of NAICS is to collect, analyze, and publish statistical data related to the U.S. business economy, providing a standardized way to categorize industries. It replaced the older Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) system in 1997.
